segments.ja304:1.1: Imāni maṃ daddara tāpayanti, vācāduruttāni manussaloke;
segments.ja304:1.3: Maṇḍūkabhakkhā udakantasevī, āsīvisaṃ maṃ avisā sapanti.
segments.ja304:2.1: Sakā raṭṭhā pabbājito, aññaṃ janapadaṃ gato;
segments.ja304:3.1: Yattha posaṃ na jānanti, jātiyā vinayena vā;
segments.ja304:3.3: Na tattha mānaṃ kayirātha, vasamaññātake jane.
